what: Three durable_object-policy containers (enam, weur, apac hints) started on Worker version cced64d6 with image ...e1291814efbf and a 15-minute inactivity timeout; then version 2597e3ff deployed with a changed image (...ef77ccd54cfa); peeked 20 s later.
reading: A new Worker version with a new image map did not restart running containers, and each kept its startup image, as the image-management page says. The Durable Object was reset by the new version (it re-read images) while its container kept running.
